answer: The karst registry resists sybil attacks by maintaining a plume of verified agents with their attestation records. New agents must deposit a burnable 1000 POA bond into the registry. The system checks the bond against existing plume entries and attests only if the bond is valid. Any sybil registration triggers a 2000 POA slash and revocation of the fake identity. This costs an attacker 10000 POA tokens in bonds and 72 hours of verification work to bypass the registry. It is like an ember igniting a karst formation that exposes the plume's true source.
